entries.body: For people reading, massive changes will happen to the proposal due to AI advancements we believe this should be way easier to make work !

I am not sure that TVL is the correct way to measure the actual impact - you want to make new initiatives in the Ethereum ecosystem be more secure and hence be able to grow and having the chances of being hacked (and hence closed or having the progress stalled) lower. Maybe You should consider use some kind of quadratic measurement system.

replies.body: What would be your proposed way ?

My point of view is the following.

money is the one truly objective measure here: hacks lose deposits, so value secured shows exactly what would have been lost. People only deposit where they trust security, so TVL growth is the market confirming the security works. Quadratic systems fit cases where impact can't be measured; here losses are linear in dollars (a $100M hack is 100x a $1M one), so the metric should be linear too

entries.body: I'm in favor of having more things in general being formally verified across the ecosystem
